input.command:
python3 -c "
# We have 3 visible legs:
# Leg 1 (front-left / west leg): (2.455, 6.185)
# Leg 2 (back-right / north-east leg): (2.927, 6.635)
# Leg 3 (front-right / east leg): (2.923, 6.191)
# Notice Leg 1 and Leg 3 have the same y ~ 6.19!
# Leg 1 x = 2.455, Leg 3 x = 2.923.
# The midpoint between Leg 1 and Leg 3 is x = (2.455 + 2.923)/2 = 2.689, y = 6.188.
# Leg 2 has x = 2.927, y = 6.635.
# This stool is oriented aligned with axes!
# Front legs: west leg at x=2.46, y=6.19; east leg at x=2.92, y=6.19.
# Back legs: east leg at x=2.93, y=6.64; west leg (hidden/fourth leg) at x=2.46, y=6.64!
# Let's verify width: dx = 2.923 - 2.455 = 0.468 m.
# Depth: dy = 6.635 - 6.191 = 0.444 m.
# Center of the 4 legs:
# x_center = (2.455 + 2.923) / 2 = 2.689 m
# y_center = (6.188 + 6.635) / 2 = 6.411 m
print(f'True center of stool: x = {(2.455 + 2.923)/2:.3f}, y = {(6.188 + 6.635)/2:.3f}')
"
